ValidationRule.description: Outgoing Exchange Partner Transcript Received can be checked only when all transcript section input fields are populated. Mirrors V_INC_Transcript_Dispatch_Details for outgoing cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Outgoing_Exchange' && ISCHANGED(Partner_Transcript_Received__c) && Partner_Transcript_Received__c && ( ISBLANK(Transcript_Notes__c) || ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c) || ISPICKVAL(Delivery_Mode__c, '') || ISBLANK(Dispatch_Address__c) || ISPICKVAL(Dispatch_Mode__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before checking Partner Transcript Received, complete all Transcript section fields: Transcript Notes, Tracking Number, Delivery Mode, Dispatch Address, and Dispatch Mode.
